candidate.definition_en: Involving competition or wanting to win and be better than others.
candidate.explanation_ar: تنافسي، يعني بيحب المنافسة وعايز يكسب دايماً، أو بيئة فيها منافسة قوية زي السوق.

senses.definition_en: Wanting very much to win and be more successful than others.
senses.explanation_ar: شخص تنافسي، يحب الفوز والتفوق على الآخرين.
examples: She is a very competitive player who hates losing.

senses.definition_en: Involving a lot of competition, or offering prices and quality as good as or better than rivals.
senses.explanation_ar: يتسم بالمنافسة القوية، أو يقدم أسعاراً وشروطاً جيدة تنافس الآخرين في السوق.
examples: They offer competitive prices to attract new customers.
The job market is highly competitive right now.
She is a very competitive player who hates losing.
They offer competitive prices to attract new customers.
The job market is highly competitive right now.
candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Compete' 'ينافس'.. في الـ 'Competition' 'المسابقة' لازم تكون 'Competitive' عشان تكسب.
